compute_first_rows_from_parquet: compute the first rows of a dataset split from parquet files using RowsIndex and anyio
compute_first_rows_from_streaming: compute the first rows of a dataset split using streaming mode from huggingface.co
run_split_first_rows_job: run the SplitFirstRowsJobRunner to get first rows of a dataset split with parquet fallback to streaming
review_split_first_rows_fallback: review the SplitFirstRowsJobRunner compute method that falls back from parquet to streaming on error
refactor_rows_content_retrieval: refactor the get_rows_content inner function to change how rows are fetched from parquet or streaming
